name: Design
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the ultimate Designer, having created the heavens and the earth at the beginning (Genesis 1:1) and forming mankind in His own image (Genesis 1:27). The divine design is evident not only in humanity but throughout nature, as the creatures and the earth itself testify to the handiwork of the Lord (Job 12:7-9). Furthermore, God’s intentional design is reflected in the detailed instructions given to Moses to construct the tabernacle exactly according to the pattern shown on the mountain (Exodus 25:40), underscoring the order and purpose inherent in God’s creative work.
